scale.instruction: 1 = strongly agree ... 6 = strongly disagree. No neutral midpoint by design.

scoring.letters: first letter if ratio >= 0.5 else second letter; AT: A if ratio >= 0.5 else T

questions.en: Parties and talking with people recharge me rather than drain me.
questions.zh: 参加聚会、和人交流能让我恢复精力，而不是消耗精力。

questions.en: After spending a long time with people, I urgently need time alone to recharge.
questions.zh: 长时间与人相处后，我迫切需要独处来"回血"。

questions.en: When I run into a problem, I tend to talk it over with someone and clarify my thinking as I talk.
questions.zh: 遇到问题，我倾向于找人讨论，边聊边理清思路。

questions.en: Before I open my mouth, I usually get my thoughts straight in my head first.
questions.zh: 开口前，我通常先在脑子里把话想清楚再说。

questions.en: Lively gatherings excite me, and after they end I still want to keep talking to people.
questions.zh: 热闹的场合让我兴奋，结束后我还想继续找人聊。

questions.en: Spending a whole day alone does not bore me; I actually find it very comfortable.
questions.zh: 一个人待一整天我也不会觉得无聊，反而很自在。

questions.en: In team discussions I am often the one who throws out topics and sets the pace.
questions.zh: 团队讨论时，我常主动抛话题、带节奏。

questions.en: In a crowd I am more often the listener than the speaker.
questions.zh: 在人群中，我更多时候是倾听者而不是发言者。

questions.en: When making decisions, I mainly rely on practical experience and solid data.
questions.zh: 做决定时，我主要依赖实际经验和确凿的数据。

questions.en: When making decisions, I trust my intuition and my sense of where things are heading.
questions.zh: 做决定时，我更相信自己的直觉和对未来的预感。

questions.en: When reviewing a plan, I focus first on concrete details and actionable steps.
questions.zh: 看方案时，我优先关注具体细节和可落地的步骤。

questions.en: When reviewing a plan, I tend to think of the overall approach and the potential possibilities first.
questions.zh: 看方案时，我更容易先想到整体思路和潜在可能性。

questions.en: When learning something new, I follow the steps hands-on and memorize the details.
questions.zh: 学新东西时，我习惯按步骤实操、把细节记牢。

questions.en: When learning something new, I build the overall framework first and understand the principles behind it.
questions.zh: 学新东西时，我习惯先搭整体框架、理解背后原理。

questions.en: Recalling an event, I can often remember specific scene details and the exact words used.
questions.zh: 回忆一件事时，我常能想起具体的场景细节和原话。

questions.en: I am often dissatisfied with current practice and always want to try newer, better ways.
questions.zh: 我对现有做法常常不满，总想尝试更新更好的方式。

questions.en: When a friend confides in me, I tend to give analysis and solutions directly.
questions.zh: 朋友倾诉时，我更倾向于直接给分析和解决办法。

questions.en: When a friend confides in me, I tend to comfort them first so they feel understood.
questions.zh: 朋友倾诉时，我更倾向于先安慰、让他感觉被理解。

questions.en: For important decisions, I care most about soundness: whether the reasoning holds up.
questions.zh: 做重要决定时，我最看重合理性、是否经得起推敲。

questions.en: For important decisions, I care most about whether it matches what my heart truly wants.
questions.zh: 做重要决定时，我最看重是否符合自己的心意。

questions.en: When rules clash with human considerations, I believe fairness and principle come first.
questions.zh: 当规则与人情冲突时，我认为公平和原则优先。

questions.en: When rules clash with human considerations, I believe the specific situation and human feelings should be accommodated.
questions.zh: 当规则与人情冲突时，我认为应照顾具体情况与人情。

questions.en: When helping someone decide, I would rather tell the truth even if it is unpleasant to hear.
questions.zh: 帮人拿主意时，我宁可说真话，哪怕话不顺耳。

questions.en: In an argument, I care a lot about the atmosphere and the other person's feelings.
questions.zh: 与人争论时，我很在意气氛和对方的感受。

questions.en: I like to plan things ahead of time and push forward according to the plan.
questions.zh: 我习惯把事情提前规划好，并按计划推进。

questions.en: I prefer to respond flexibly and dislike being boxed in by a plan.
questions.zh: 我更喜欢灵活应对，不喜欢被计划框死。

questions.en: My desk / workspace is usually well organized and I know exactly where things stand.
questions.zh: 我的桌面/工作区通常井然有序、心里有数。

questions.en: I often have several things open at once, and changing my mind midway is common for me.
questions.zh: 我常同时开着好几件事，中途改主意很常见。

questions.en: Before traveling, I carefully book the itinerary and study the guides.
questions.zh: 旅行前，我会仔细订好行程和攻略。

questions.en: When traveling, I prefer to set only a rough direction and decide the rest when I get there.
questions.zh: 旅行时，我倾向只定个大方向，到了再说。

questions.en: When tasks pile up, I like to make a list and handle them one by one by priority.
questions.zh: 任务多时，我喜欢列清单、按优先级一件件处理。

questions.en: For me, plans cannot keep up with change, so even when I make them I often do not follow through.
questions.zh: 对我来说，计划赶不上变化，订了也常不执行。

questions.en: When I hit a setback, I can adjust my mindset fairly quickly and do not sink into self-doubt for long.
questions.zh: 遇到挫折时，我能较快调整心态，不会长时间陷入自我怀疑。

questions.en: Facing criticism, I can usually treat it as a reference rather than let it shake my emotions.
questions.zh: 面对批评，我通常能把它当参考，而不是被它动摇情绪。

questions.en: I am generally confident in my abilities and decisions and rarely go back and forth.
questions.zh: 我对自己的能力和决定总体很有信心，很少反复纠结。

questions.en: I often reflect on my performance and worry whether I am doing well enough.
questions.zh: 我常常反思自己的表现，担心自己是不是做得不够好。

questions.en: After making a decision, I sometimes replay it and wonder whether I chose wrong.
questions.zh: 做完决定后，我偶尔会反复回想，琢磨是不是选错了。

questions.en: Other people's opinions affect my mood and confidence to some extent.
questions.zh: 周围人的评价会在一定程度上影响我的状态和信心。
